## Notes

Spiderling Studios; early access 2015-01-28; full release 2020-02-18; PC, Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, mobile (2025); 55 campaign levels on four islands; logic blocks (timers, gates, sensors); PC multiplayer and level editor added December 2017; Splintered Sea expansion adds water physics.
